t: EPC2018 | Wave Function Collapse in Bad North | Oskar Stalberg

q.x: The creator Oskar Stålberg has a great overview talk of Wave Function Collapse and how he applied it to his previous game Bad North - it’s absolutely worth a watch! [link]

desc: Bad North is a procedurally generated strategy game about fighting Vikings. Oskar Stalberg will talk about how the Wave Function Collapse algorithm is employed to magically assemble idyllic island dioramas from handcrafted tilesets.
